title: 2-DOF Planar SCARA Arm
description: Two-axis planar SCARA pick-and-place robot arm with base pedestal, shoulder and elbow revolute joints with limits, complete inertial tensors, and matching visual and collision geometries.
code:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="planar_scara_arm">
  <link name="base_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.15" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="8.5"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.08" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.08" iyz="0" izz="0.06"/>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.15" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry><cylinder radius="0.10" length="0.30"/></geometry>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.15" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry><cylinder radius="0.10" length="0.30"/></geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="upper_arm">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.20 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.4"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.012" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.035" iyz="0" izz="0.038"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.20 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry><box size="0.40 0.06 0.05"/></geometry>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.20 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry><box size="0.40 0.06 0.05"/></geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="forearm">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.15 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="1.6"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.008" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.020" iyz="0" izz="0.022"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.15 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry><box size="0.30 0.05 0.04"/></geometry>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.15 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry><box size="0.30 0.05 0.04"/></geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <joint name="shoulder_joint" type="revolute">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="upper_arm"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0.30" rpy="0 0 0"/>

    <limit lower="-2.618" upper="2.618" effort="25.0" velocity="4.50"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
